d: Company Description FansPass | فانز باس is a Saudi-based ticket marketplace that allows fans to buy and sell tickets for sports, entertainment, concerts, and global events through a secure, user-friendly platform. The company focuses on connecting verified buyers and sellers, ensuring safe and reliable transactions. FansPass provides clear guarantees and dedicated customer support throughout the ticket-buying journey. The platform is designed to enhance fan experiences by making access to events more seamless, transparent, and trustworthy.

Role Description The Graphic Designer at FansPass | فانز باس is a full-time remote role responsible for creating visually compelling assets that support marketing campaigns, product interfaces, and brand communications. Day-to-day tasks include designing digital graphics for social media, web, and mobile, developing and refining logos and icons, and ensuring consistent branding across all visual materials. The role involves collaborating with marketing, product, and content teams to translate ideas into clear visual concepts, preparing files for production, and iterating designs based on feedback and performance data. The Graphic Designer will also help maintain and evolve the brand’s visual identity, contribute to design guidelines, and support ad-hoc design needs in a fast-paced environment.
q: li
Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with a portfolio demonstrating digital and brand-focused work.
li
Proficiency in Logo Design and Branding to create and refine visual identities and maintain brand consistency.
li
Solid understanding of Typography, including layout, hierarchy, and readability in digital formats.
li
Experience using industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, or similar) and working with design systems.
li
Ability to work collaboratively in a remote, cross-functional team environment and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
li
Good communication skills and the ability to present and explain design decisions to non-design stakeholders.
li
Prior experience designing for marketplaces, e-commerce, or entertainment platforms is a plus.
li
Relevant education or equivalent practical experience in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.

d: Role Description The Quantity Surveyor at Woodly Concept will be responsible for managing all aspects of cost and commercial control across interior projects in Capital Governorate, Bahrain. This full-time, on-site role includes preparing and reviewing Bills of Quantities (BOQ), supporting tender preparation, and evaluating contractor quotations. The Quantity Surveyor will track project budgets, monitor expenditures, and update cost forecasts to ensure financial objectives are met. Daily tasks include preparing cost reports, verifying measurements, assessing variations and claims, and collaborating with project managers, engineers, and procurement teams to support effective decision-making. The role also involves maintaining accurate records, ensuring compliance with contracts and standards, and contributing to value engineering and risk assessments.
q: li
Candidates should possess strong skills in Cost Control and Cost Management to monitor budgets, manage expenditures, and support commercial decisions.
li
Candidates should possess practical experience in BOQ preparation and measurement to support tenders, valuations, and contractor payments.
li
Candidates should possess capabilities in Cost Planning to develop project cost estimates, forecasts, and value engineering proposals.
li
Candidates should possess proficiency in Cost Reporting to prepare clear, timely financial reports, cash flow projections, and variance analyses.
li
Candidates should possess familiarity with construction contracts and standard forms (e.g., FIDIC or similar) and basic knowledge of local regulations.
li
Candidates should possess strong analytical and numerical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret drawings and technical documents.
li
Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with multidisciplinary project teams and external stakeholders.
li
Candidates should possess proficiency in relevant software such as MS Excel and quantity surveying or cost management tools; CAD familiarity is an advantage.
li
Candidates should possess a degree or diploma in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications are a plus.
li
Candidates should possess the ability to work on-site in Capital Governorate, Bahrain, manage multiple deadlines, and maintain high ethical and professional standards.
